The existing grounding-independence result and Third Man sensitivity models discriminate several proposed bridges, but do not refute all possible participation schemas. Full findings and exact reusable theorem names are preserved in docs/participation-grounding.md. No instance_of_schema registration, new philosophical claim, proof of an impossible schema, or frontier closure is asserted.
